callouts.lead: Calibration gating prevented an unverified small-model handoff even when raw `route` favored `small` at 94.6%.
callouts.body: Because `small` (`gpt-5.4-mini`) passed only 2/16 support tickets in calibration, `small_gate` froze to `null`: Decision-1 routed answerable tickets to `gpt-6.1-sol` (accepted=true), whereas Strands had `sufficient_gate=null` and sent all 16 support rows to simulated human review.

callouts.lead: Across all 544 formal jobs, 537 were schema-valid and 456 were machine-accepted; all 8 E2E paired bootstrap checks are `inconclusive`.
callouts.body: Support routing degraded acceptance vs Strong-only (-25.0 pp for Decision-1, -68.8 pp for Strands/Mini); RAG reached 16/16 on Rule, Mini, Sol, and Strands, but 4 template clusters (8 base cases) cannot prove <=2% non-inferiority.

callouts.lead: Why the `✕` misses happened: calibration abstention, ZH JSON drift, and unsafe uncalibrated booleans.
callouts.body: Mini-label had 1/8 false allow on unsafe gating; Mini-prob had 5/8 ZH scoring schema/mean failures; Strands 2B had high ordinal spread on 5-level scoring (MAE 0.7412) and abstained on all 16 support tickets.

cards.headline: One `/v1/systemone` contract, two confidence math worlds
cards.subtitle: Both Microsoft-Decision-1 and Strands Decider consume the same structured `state + questions` payload and score `<answer>` in a single forward pass—but their Score confidence formulas and verifiers differ.
cards.transition: ↓ server renders XML tags & PointerHead scores option end-tokens at <answer> without autoregressive decoding
cards.bottom_code:
<state>{"language":"en","request":"Recover access after changing email..."}</state>
<question type="score">
Score the passage relevance from 0 to 4.
<options>
0 - 0: Irrelevant · 1 - 1: Weak · 2 - 2: Partial · 3 - 3: Good · 4 - 4: Exact match
</options>
</question>
<answer>
# Choice confidence (Jev & Strands): (N * p_max - 1) / (N - 1)
# Strands Score confidence (std-dev): clamp((sigma_max - sigma) / (sigma_max - sqrt(0.1)), 0, 1)
# Harness verifier: checks 4dp half-unit rounding bounds & per-attempt 5-min Entra bearer refresh

callouts.lead: Zero generated output tokens for native deciders vs. full JSON token generation for LLM probability wrappers.
callouts.body: Strands encodes `<state>` once via `_fork_layered_cache` (Gated DeltaNet conv/recurrent states + attention KV) and projects the `<answer>` hidden state (`pointer_dim=768` in v1 soup) against each option's final token.

callouts.lead: Prompting a small LLM for JSON probability distributions caused a -62.5 pt Chinese scoring collapse (100% EN → 37.5% ZH).
callouts.body: While `gpt-5.4-mini` achieved 100% (16/16) in label-only scoring, asking it for 5-level probabilities produced 5 Chinese schema/expectation mismatches—showing why native single-pass deciders (`Decision-1` 16/16, ECE 0.0149) avoid JSON wrapper fragility.

callouts.lead: P95 and P99 are intentionally reported as `null` (`NA`) under the pre-registered sample-size guardrail.

cards.headline: Where native decision models fit, and where they do not
cards.subtitle: Engineering guidance synthesized from 544 formal test rows, 1,179 live model calls, and three concrete routing architectures (TypeSafe Jev, Azure Decision-1, local Strands Decider).
good_fit: Sub-second closed-set rubric scoring & relevance grading (Decision-1: 16/16, MAE 0.0082, ECE 0.0149 at 701 ms)
Calibrated probability gating with explicit abstention (Decision-1: 15/16, 0/8 false allow, Brier 0.0051 at 636 ms)
High-volume tool/intent classification where $0.042/1M input & 0 output tokens beat LLM JSON wrappers
Multi-question shared-prefix fanout over a single state payload (`/v1/systemone`)
GPU/MPS-backed edge deployment of Apache-2.0 Strands Decider when data cannot leave local infrastructure
not_for: Replacing deterministic authorization, ownership, tool allowlists, or refund/money policy checks
Claiming E2E multi-model routing cost/speed wins when the small generator fails task acceptance (Support 2/16)
Running 2B Gated DeltaNet models on x64-emulated CPU for latency-sensitive online routing (6.3–33.0 s)
Treating uncalibrated LLM boolean labels (`Mini-label` 1/8 false allow) or ZH JSON probabilities as calibrated gates
Extrapolating 8-base-case pilot intervals (`status=inconclusive`) as population <=2% non-inferiority guarantees
